arguments.help: Specific storm ID or name

Auto-pick the best observing geostationary satellite for the target location (e.g. Himawari for the Philippines/WPac, GOES-East for the Atlantic, GK-2A for East Asia, MTG for Africa/Europe when EUMETSAT credentials are present). Candidates are ranked by viewing geometry, then probed in order until one has data at the requested or latest timestamp. Overrides --him/--gk2a/--goes/--mtg and --multi.
Comma-separated basin filter for current ATCF storms. Examples: WP, EPAC, CPAC, AL/ATL, IO, SH, SI, AU, SP. Omit to process every active storm.

Global mode: fetch GOES + Himawari-9 (+Himawari-8 fallback) + GK-2A + MTG at the SAME timestamp and render them as stacked full-disk panels on one world map

Bird's Eye View: red/cyan anaglyph pseudo-3D cloud rendering using Himawari-9 (140.7E) + GK-2A (128.2E) IR observations at the same timestamp. The parallax between the two view angles encodes cloud-top height as depth (view with red/cyan 3D glasses, or as a pseudo-3D impression without).

SATAID-style 'bird setup' perspective view. Flat 2D IR data is projected through a virtual perspective camera; cloud-top heights (from BT) lift each pixel toward the camera, giving the classic SATAID 3D look. Tune with --beyevs-dip / --beyevs-azimuth / --beyevs-range / --beyevs-height / --beyevs-fov.
